summary: In the executive office, Agent Jones looks at Morpheus and voices his read of the situation: "I think they're trying to save him." The line frames Morpheus, held here, as the target of an incoming rescue effort, with Jones interpreting the attackers' intent rather than merely reacting to it.

what_changes.before: Watching Morpheus without stating what the intruders intend
what_changes.after: Articulating a conclusion about the intruders' goal
what_changes.evidence: I think they're trying to save him.

event_hint.one_line: Amid the government-building incursion, Jones names the rescuers' aim while Morpheus is held.
